surface_mechanism_description: The self-limiting growth mechanism in pulsed PECVD is fundamentally different from ALD. First, the precursor must be inert with dry O2 so that no deposition occurs during the plasma off step. Second, the precursor is diluted with excess O2 so that no deposition is observed under continuous wave plasma operation. Deposition is then readily achieved when the plasma is pulsed at a low frequency.
